Privacy notice

Privacy notice

Last updated: 2 November 2026

This notice explains what personal data we receive through this website, why, and what rights you have. We collect as little as possible.

Who is responsible

WorkGuardAI is the controller of the personal data described here.

WorkGuardAI Ab
Business ID 3465002-8
Espoo, Finland
Email: ek@workguardai.com

What we collect

When you send the contact form: your name, organisation, role, email address and message, the interest you chose and the language of the page. Depending on the interest, also: for a pilot project, the type of site and whether you have DWG plans; for a research or education collaboration, what you would like to explore and your timeline; for a meeting at an event, the event name. When you email us: what you write and your email address.

When you choose Updates: your email address, your consent and the language of the page.

This website uses no cookies, no analytics and no tracking. Fonts and images are served from this site, not from third parties.

Why we use it

To reply to your request and to discuss a possible pilot, collaboration, event meeting, press request or other cooperation with you. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before a possible agreement (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)) and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries (Article 6(1)(f)).

If you sign up to follow our progress, we use your email address to send you occasional updates. The legal basis is your consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time by replying to any email from us.

Who processes it for us

  • Formspree, Inc. (United States) receives the form and delivers it to our email. Your data is transferred to the United States for this; Formspree's privacy policy states that it makes such transfers as permitted by law and keeps the data appropriately protected.
  • Google Workspace provides our email and stores the messages we receive.
  • GitHub, Inc. hosts this website. Like any web server, it may log technical data such as IP addresses for security.

We do not sell your data or share it with anyone else.

How long we keep it

We copy each request into our own records and then delete it from Formspree. If a request does not lead to a pilot or other cooperation, we delete it no later than 12 months after our last contact. We keep an updates sign-up until you unsubscribe, and then delete it.

Your rights

You can ask to see the data we hold about you, to correct or delete it, to restrict or object to its use, or to receive it in a portable format. Write to ek@workguardai.com and we will reply within one month.

You can also complain to a data protection authority. In Finland this is the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi); you can also contact the authority in your own country.

Changes

If we change how we handle personal data, we will update this page and the date above.
